The two threatening archfey are explicitly paired in their reference notes; the complete marked span contains their two names.

The question asks whether the paired entities are two people, and the answer is that nobody is sure. This closely matches the documented uncertainty about Harrow and Wend. Hollowdark is the nearby place name and a possible spoken confusion, so this less certain recognition is marked supported.

Secretzone may contain Seeker and turn rather than a name alone. Seeker has just acted, while Riswynn answers and acts next; replacing it with Riswynn would impose the expected order over a possible spoken mistake.

The discussion concerns the navy fighting at Darba and in Dunmar, followed immediately by an unmarked self-correction to Dunmar. The marked darkness could be a place-name recognition error or the start of a spoken stumble; no unique spoken form is established.
Ordinary descriptive wording, conversational fragments, numbers, or combat rules. These spans do not supply a supported name or setting-term correction and remain unchanged outside this pass.
Prismwell is the likely named destination, but the complete marked span also contains still. It could include ordinary words beyond the name; replacing it would silently reconstruct or drop wording.

The question occurs between discussion of chalyte and fey scholarship, but the marked phrase does not establish a recoverable name, people, or organization. No complete name replacement is supported by the inspected references or session record.
The opening contrasts Delwath telling stories with the companion training the wyvern; the later recap names that rider Wellby, as does the session record.
The adjacent epithet Silence That Follows and rulership of Hollowdark uniquely identify Wend.
